about: Swap benchmark (2026-10-27): an object or a garment selected by name (SAM 3.1, select.byText) and replaced by a prompt. Item swaps on the CC0 stock set (bench\stock, stock-fetch.ps1); outfit swaps on people generated here with Krea 2 (gen), the generating prompt kept with the case. `select` is the detector's phrase, `fill` the Generative Fill prompt, `edit` the Generative Edit instruction.

generate.prompt: full-body photograph of a young woman wearing a blue denim jacket over a white t-shirt and black jeans, standing on a city sidewalk, natural daylight, 35mm photo
waist-up photograph of a man in his thirties wearing a plain white t-shirt, sitting at a table in a bright cafe, natural window light
full-body photograph of a woman wearing a simple red dress standing in a green park in summer, soft afternoon light

cases.fill: a glass of red wine standing on the wooden table
cases.edit: Replace the coffee cup with a glass of red wine.
Replace the glass with a white ceramic coffee mug.
Replace the top hat with a straw cowboy hat.
Replace the glasses with round black sunglasses.
Replace the clear umbrella with a bright red umbrella.

cases.fill: a red vintage scooter parked against the wall
cases.edit: Replace the bicycle with a red vintage scooter.

cases.fill: a black cat sitting on the lawn
cases.edit: Replace the dog with a black cat sitting on the lawn.
Replace the wooden bench with a modern white stone bench.

cases.fill: a thin gold bracelet on the wrist
cases.edit: Replace the wristwatch with a thin gold bracelet.
Replace the fire hydrant with a blue postbox.
Replace the motorcycle in front with a red vespa scooter.
Replace the denim jacket with a yellow hooded raincoat.

cases.fill: a navy suit jacket over a white shirt and a dark tie
cases.edit: Dress the man in a navy suit jacket over a white shirt and a dark tie instead of the t-shirt.
Replace the red dress with a green floral summer dress.
Replace the jacket with a black leather jacket.
